full_prompt_en: A square twilight architectural photograph shows a sculptural white building reflected almost perfectly in a still dark pool. The horizon line between building and reflection runs across the middle of the frame. Above it, thick blue-gray storm clouds press low, with a narrow peach-pink opening at the far left. The building has broad smooth concrete ribbons that sweep horizontally and curve upward into a floating oval roof. A darker glazed cylindrical volume sits beneath the roof near the center, its vertical window mullions visible through the deep shade. A long white ramp rises gently from the left and crosses in front of the glass, then joins the higher curved level. On the right, a deep cantilevered canopy extends over a sheltered opening washed with warm amber light. A few tiny people stand or walk near this opening, supplying scale to the sweeping structure. Small lamps punctuate the near terrace and repeat as points in the reflection. The pool fills the lower half with dark blue water, reproducing the roof, ramps, glazing, lamps, and pink strip of sky with little distortion. A thin concrete edge separates the real building from its mirrored counterpart. Cool cloud-filtered light from above gives the white surfaces a blue cast, while interior lamps make selected undersides glow gold. Smooth solid planes contrast with transparent dark glass and liquid reflection. There is no readable signage. The overall composition is calm and monumental, using stacked curves, strict horizontal symmetry, and cool dusk against warm recesses to make the building appear to float.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形暮色建筑摄影呈现一座雕塑般的白色建筑，几乎完整地倒映在平静深色水池里。建筑与倒影之间的水平线横过画面中部。上方，厚重蓝灰风暴云低低压下，最左侧留一道桃粉色天光。建筑由宽阔平顺混凝土带构成，水平扫过并向上弯为漂浮的椭圆屋顶。屋顶下方中央有一座更暗的玻璃圆柱体，竖向窗框在深影中可见。一道长白坡道从左侧缓缓升起，越过玻璃前方，接上更高的弧形层。右侧，深悬挑雨棚伸出一个被暖琥珀色光洗亮的遮蔽开口。几名极小人物在开口附近站立或行走，为宽阔结构提供尺度。小灯点缀近处平台，并在倒影里重复。水池以深蓝水填满下半部，屋顶、坡道、玻璃、灯与粉色天边都被几乎无畸变地复制。一条细混凝土池边把真实建筑与镜像分开。来自上方的冷云光让白色表面染上蓝色，室内灯则使选定下表面发金光。平顺坚实体块对照透明深色玻璃与液体倒影。画中没有可读招牌。整体构图平静而雄伟，以叠置曲线、严格水平对称和冷暮色对暖凹处，使建筑仿佛漂浮。
style_prompt_en: The photograph emphasizes smooth sweeping white surfaces, deep glazed recesses, and near-perfect reflection. Broad curved bands overlap to create a layered horizontal rhythm, while one darker central mass anchors the motion. Cool blue-gray ambient light covers the large planes; small warm amber pockets reveal depth beneath them. A low level viewpoint and centered waterline make upper and lower halves nearly symmetrical. Hard concrete edges remain crisp against soft cloud texture, and glossy reflection doubles the geometry while retaining subtle liquid softness. Tiny scale cues are absorbed by the grand forms. The overall effect is serene, futuristic, and monumental, with curvature, tonal restraint, and reflected light defining the visual language.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅摄影强调平顺扫过的白色表面、深暗玻璃凹处和近乎完整的倒影。宽大弯曲色带互相重叠，形成层叠水平节奏，一块较暗的中央体积稳住运动。冷蓝灰环境光覆盖大平面；小面积暖琥珀色光区揭示其下纵深。低视点和居中水线使上下两半接近对称。坚硬混凝土边缘在柔云肌理前保持清楚，发亮倒影复制几何，同时保有微妙液体柔感。细小尺度线索被宏大的形体吸收。整体效果宁静、未来感且雄伟，由曲率、明度克制和反射光界定视觉语言。
theme_en: A white curving cultural building reflected in a still pool at dusk
theme_zh: 暮色中倒映在静水池里的白色曲线文化建筑
name: Oscar Niemeyer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
